 Order. Zoom teleconference will not be available for this meeting, but members of the public

must provide your full name, but please do not provide any other personal information that you

   Agenda Item No.: 2.A
  Mtg. Date: 03/01/2022

TO:  HONORABLE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL

FROM:  ASHFORD BALL, SENIOR MANAGEMENT ANALYST

THRU:  ELAINE JENG P.E., CITY MANAGER

SUBJECT:  RECEIVE AND FILE AN UPDATE ON THE STATUS OF THE EXPERT'S
  REVIEW OF THE CANYON MANAGEMENT DRAFT ORDINANCE.

DATE:  March 01, 2022

BACKGROUND:
At the Fire Fuel meeting on February 8, 2022 the Fire Fuel Committee gave staff direction to
hire Wildland Res Management (WRM) to review and provide feedback on the draft ordinance
to require fire fuel abatement in the canyons by March 1, 2022.

DISCUSSION:
Since the last Fire Fuel Committee meeting, staff has worked with WRM and the City Attorney
to construct a Professional Services Agreement (PSA). Staff is still coordinating with legal, and
WRM to complete the PSA and expect to execute the PSA by the week of March 1, 2022.

In preparation for the work, WRM requested the following documents in order to better provide
a comprehensive review:

  Community Wildfire Protection Plan (CWPP)
  Local Hazard Mitigation Plan
  Safety Element
  Dead Vegetation and Nuisance Abatement Ordinances (Chapter 8.24 & 8.30 of the
  Municipal Code)
  Script for the Canyon Management Videos

If the PSA is executed on the week of March 1, WRM anticipates completing their review of
the draft ordinance by Monday April 11, 2022.

FISCAL IMPACT:
None.

RECOMMENDATION:
Receive and file an update regarding review of the draft ordinance

THRU:  ELAINE JENG P.E., CITY MANAGER

SUBJECT:  DEVELOP A LIST WILDFIRE MITIGATION MEASURES FOR THE CITY
  COUNCIL'S CONSIDERATION.

DATE:  March 01, 2022

BACKGROUND:
At the February 8, 2022 Fire Fuel Committee meeting, the Committee discussed that the wrap
of the committee's work would include a final version of the draft vegetation management in
the canyons ordinance. While the draft ordinance is being reviewed by the hired experts, the
Fire Fuel Committee also wanted to present the City Council with a list of other wildfire
mitigation measures for consideration.

DISCUSSION:
The Fire Fuel Committee requested that staff place on the agenda for the March 1, 2022
meeting to discuss and develop a list of wildfire mitigation measures for the City Council's
consideration.

FISCAL IMPACT:
None.

RECOMMENDATION:
Discuss and develop measures.
